ThingDef.description: A nice-looking collared shirt with buttons. A step up from the regular t-shirt, and worn by children who want to be treated like adults.
ThingDef.label: kid button-down shirt

ThingDef.description: A child-sized duster coat for blocking the sun and grit of the outdoors. Essential for any frontier deputy, and good protection if the most dangerous thing around your settlement is a manhunting rabbit.
ThingDef.label: kid duster

ThingDef.description: A long robe embedded with special psychic focusing materials. These enhance psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat. Coveted amongst the most elite psycasting apprentices of the empire, it is a symbol of top students.
ThingDef.label: kid eltex robe
kid eltex shirt
ThingDef.description: A shirt embedded with special psychic focusing materials. These enhance psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat. The fashionable choice among aspiring psycaster apprentices, they are hard to find outside academics of the empire.

ThingDef.label: kid eltex vest
ThingDef.description: A thin vest embedded with special psychic focusing materials. These enhance psychic sensitivity and help dissipate neural heat. Coveted by children of the upper class in psycasting apprenticeships as a sign of true class and old money wealth.

ThingDef.label: kid heavy bandolier
ThingDef.description: A heavy shoulder-belt for keeping spare munitions close at hand. It allows quick access to bullets, grenades, arrows, or whatever the user needs, reducing their weapon's ranged cooldown. Due to its bulk, it can't be worn under other clothing. Children tend to pick up cool rocks and sticks and store them in their bandoliers as well.

ThingDef.label: kid jacket
ThingDef.description: A tough jacket to stop scrapes and bruises, and to keep one warm in chilly weather. A favorite of schoolyard bullies, it is often worn by children who say the parka is worn by wimps.

ThingDef.label: kid flak vest
ThingDef.description: A small vest with armor plates inserted on the chest and back. Popular among hussar cadets and warworld conscripts, if a child is wearing this, something has gone terribly wrong already.

ThingDef.label: kid flak pants
ThingDef.description: A child-sized pair of pants with armor plates sewn in. Popular among military school cadets for both their comfort and protection, they are often flaunted as a status symbol to those with mere regular pants.

ThingDef.label: kid flak jacket
ThingDef.description: A small yet tough fabric jacket with armor plates sewn in. While it's not as good as solid armor, it offers effective protection against raiders and opportunistic wargs while remaining quite comfortable. It is credited with saving the lives of many children on the rimworlds by giving adults time to reach and rescue them.

ThingDef.label: kid marine armor
ThingDef.description: A child-sized suit of powered armor. Layered plasteel-weave plates are very effective at stopping attacks, with few vulnerable joint sections. Neuro-memetic assistors allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily.\n\nArmor like this is often gifted to military cadets showing great potential, and lets them survive long enough to reach said potential.

ThingDef.label: kid prestige marine armor
ThingDef.description: A child-sized suit of powered armor. Layered plasteel-weave plates are very effective at stopping attacks, with few vulnerable joint sections. Neuro-memetic assistors allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those destined to become high ranked military officers. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.

ThingDef.label: kid recon armor
ThingDef.description: A child-sized suit of light partially-powered armor, designed to permit quick movement. Lightweight plasteel-weave plates block attacks without compromising mobility, and neuro-memetic assistors in the lower body allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily.\n\nArmor like this is often used by hussar-xenogerm candidates and glitterworld police cadets, and is coveted by many warworld conscripts.

ThingDef.label: kid prestige recon armor
ThingDef.description: A child-sized suit of light partially-powered armor, designed to permit quick movement. Plasteel-weave plates block attacks without compromising mobility, and neuro-memetic assistors in the lower body allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for the scions of esteemed military officers. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.

ThingDef.label: kid cataphract armor
ThingDef.description: A suit of heavy powered armor, built for maximum protection at the cost of mobility. Heavy layered plasteel-weave plates with solid ablative coatings stop all but the most well-aimed or powerful attacks. Neuro-memetic assistors prevent the suit's massive weight from immobilizing the wearer entirely, but the suit is still quite cumbersome.\n\nCompletely impractical for any child to wear even if assigned to patrol their outpost, it is worn only in the most desperate emergencies. If children are being sent to siege a position in this armor, their commander should re-evaluate their choices as of late.

ThingDef.label: kid prestige cataphract armor
ThingDef.description: A suit of heavy powered armor, built for maximum protection at the cost of mobility. Heavy layered plasteel-weave plates with solid ablative coatings stop all but the most well-aimed or powerful attacks. Neuro-memetic assistors prevent the suit's massive weight from immobilizing the wearer entirely, but the suit is still quite cumbersome.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity. But even this does not prevent most from seeing it as an expensive joke, as most children prefer mobility to learn and play.

ThingDef.label: kid locust armor
ThingDef.description: A variant of recon armor with an integrated burst rocket for short-ranged flight. Locust armor is slightly less protective than standard recon armor. Each jump consumes a burst of fuel, so the armor must be reloaded after several uses.\n\nUnlike most ultratech military units, locusts train primarily with melee weapons. These child-sized suits of armor are typically used for training by fighting small animals, or to leap out of the way of a raiding party. It does not stand up to any extended fight, and is best utilized to position cadets behind the adults and out of harm’s way.

ThingDef.label: kid grenadier armor
ThingDef.description: A variant of marine armor with an integrated frag launcher on the shoulder. The armor is slightly less protective than standard marine armor. The launcher can only hold a limited amount of ammo and must be reloaded after use.\n\nCadets assigned this armor are typically enrolled near sites of mechanoid activity. It is not recommended for regular use, but can help children create an opportunity to escape a fight or stop a mechanoid in its tracks.

ThingDef.label: kid phoenix armor
ThingDef.description: A variant of cataphract armor with a shoulder-mounted flamebolt launcher. This armor is slightly less protective than standard cataphract armor against normal damage, but is especially flame-resistant. The flamebolt launcher has very limited ammo and must be reloaded after use.\n\nPhoenixes specialize in clearing out very confined spaces full of enemies, with training programs for cadets in this armor being more rigorous than most. They can absorb hits while moving down a corridor, fill rooms with flame, and emerge from the smoke unscathed.

ThingDef.label: kid sash
ThingDef.description: A long strip of material worn over one shoulder. It offers minimal protection from heat, cold, and attacks. Popular among youth scouting organizations, children add badges and patches to mark their achievements.

ThingDef.label: kid lab coat
ThingDef.description: A knee-length overcoat worn over other clothing. While children are too young to conduct research alongside adults, the lab coat helps them to focus on their studies. It also has deep pockets for various shiny things they find neat.

ThingDef.label: kid mechlord suit
ThingDef.description: A child-sized power-assisted armor suit packed with mechanitor-assistance gear. The mechlord suit dramatically amplifies a mechanitor's bandwidth, but is somewhat less protective than dedicated heavy armor. Ideally, a child should not be commanding mechanoids.
